༄༅/ /nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ /bco brgyad khri chen gyis mdzad pa'o/༈/na mo gu ru badzra yo gi nī ye/de la 'dir dbang thob ca

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so//

bco brgyad khri chen gyis mdzad pa'o/ ༈ /na mo gu ru badzra yo gi nī ye/ de la 'dir dbang thob cing*/ byin brlab zab mos rgyud smin pa'i gang zag gis/ bsdus pa'i tshul gyis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs yul gsal btab nas/ bdag sogs 'gro kun deng nas byang chub bar// bla ma dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// rdzogs byang go 'phang la brten sems can kun// bsgral phyir zab mo'i rnal 'byor bsgom par bgyi// rang gi spyi bor padma zla ba'i steng*// bla ma rdor sems yab yum gsal ba yi// sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs sdig ltung bkrus// dbang bzhi thob cing gsang gsum byin brlabs gyur// oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sogs yig brgya ci nus bzlas mthar/ bla ma thog ma med pa'i sems dpa' yis// bdag gi sngon bsags sdig sgrib nyes ltung kun// byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// spyi bo'i rdor sems 'od zhu rang la thim// bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun min ni/ rang mdun nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i steng*// rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje chos// mthar skor pad zlar brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams// dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam par bzhugs// mtha' skor skyabs gnas rgya mtsho gsal ba yi// gnas gsum 'od kyis skyabs gnas ma lus pa// spyan drangs bstim pas skyabs gnas kun 'dus gyur// gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// drin can chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rje gzigs// 'di phyi bar do kun tu byin gyis rlobs// zhen pa spang ba ni/ bdag gi nyon mongs rang gzugs lus longs spyod// dgra gnyen bar ma'i snang ba ji snyed pa// rje btsun bla ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// zung 'dzin rnam rtog zhi bar byin gyis rlobs//

mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ phyi mchod nyer spyod nang mchod bdud rtsi'i sprin// gsang ba snyoms 'jug bde stong de kho na// 'khor gsum dmigs med phyag rgya chen po yis// rtsa brgyud dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams mchod// ku sa li'i tshogs bsags ni/ rang sems rnal 'byor ma dpal mkha' la thon// phyag g.yas gri gug phung po'i smin mtshams su// reg pa tsam gyis thod pa ling gis bkog /mdun du thod pa'i sgyid bu gsum gyi steng*// legs bkal stong gsum khyon dang mnyam par gyur// rang lus dum bur gtubs te de'i nang bskyur// ye shes me 'bar thod pa'i nang rdzas rnams// zhu zhing khol ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur// oṃ ā hūm̐ ha hoḥhrī/ zhes pa'i byin brlab/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes tshar bdun/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rigs drug lhar gsal zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bdud rtsi mthong reg myang bas sgrib gnyis byang*// phung po 'ja' lus sems nyid chos skur grol// sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing me tog bkram// ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis// 'gro kun rnam dag zhing du spyod par shog / dbang blang ba ni/ bla ma skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la// dbang bzhi rdzogs par gnang zhes gsol btab pas// rtsa brgyud bla mas gnang ba zhus thob ste// g.yas bskor mas rim rtsa ba'i bla mar thim// bla ma'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum 'od zer tshogs// rim dang cig car byung nas rang la thim// bla ma bstim pa ni/ rtsa ba'i bla mar rtse gcig gsol btab pas// dgyes bzhin 'od zhu rang la thim pa yis// rang sems bam̐ yig spros bral dbyings su thim// de yi ngang las snying gar e e las// chos 'byung zla dkyil dbus su bam̐ yig mthar// sngags 'phreng 'khor ba'i zer gyis gzhi lus sbyangs// 'od kyi phung por gyur las skad cig gis// rang nyid pad nyi dus mtshan 'jigs byed steng*// rnam snang rigs bdag bcas pa'i rnal 'byor ma// dmar gsal spyan gsum nam mkha'i dbyings su gzigs// phyag g.yas gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin// g.yon pas thod khrag steng phyogs bzung bas gsol// phrag pa g.yon par rdo rje'i kha ṭwāṃ bsten// thod skam dbu rgyan do shal phyag rgyas spras// zhabs zung g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskum dor thabs bzhengs// bde chen nyams 'bar ye shes me dbus rol// thugs srog 'od kyi snod bcud dngos 'dzin sbyangs// rdo rje btsun mo'i zhing skur lam gyis gsal//

'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ phaiṃ/ slar yang thugs ka'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros pas// lhan skyes zhing sngags rnal 'byor ma dpal kun// tshur 'dus dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs rang la thim// dam tshig ye shes gnyis su med par gyur// ye shes zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis snying kha'i bam̐// 'od zhu dbus su mkha' spyod dmar po dang*// byang nas g.yon bskor ljang dmar ser dang dkar// mtha' bskor sngags phreng sum cu so gnyis rnams// rnal 'byor ma dpal sum cu so gnyis gyur// oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shuddho3haṃ/ lus gnas so sor zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*// ngo bo lha la rnam pa yi ge'i gzugs// oṃ bam̐ ham̐ yoṃ hriṃ moṃ hriṃ hriṃ dang*// hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa rnams kyis mtshan pa yi// thugs ka'i lus dkyil gtso mo'i sngags phreng las// 'phros pa'i 'od kyis 'phags mchod 'gro sgrib sbyangs// pho nya gsum gyi byin rlabs nus mthu kun// bsdus thim mkha' spyod dngos grub thob par gyur// oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇa nī ye badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ dam bca'i grangs las mi nyung ba bzla/ spro na yid bzlas sogs kyi mthar/ bla ma rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas// 'gro kun mkha' spyod 'khrid par mdzad du gsol// khams gsum 'od zhu rang dang rang nyid kyang*// nā da'i bar thim 'od gsal dbyings su yal// slar yang rgyan dang phyag mtshan spangs pa yi// lha sku go chas mtshan par gsal ba'i ngang*// snang grags rtog tshogs lha sngags chos kyi sku// dga' ba gsum dang dbyer med 'dres par gyur// dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yis bdag gzhan kun// mkha' spyod chen po'i go 'phang 'grub rgyur nas// srid dang zhi ba'i rgud pa kun sel zhing*// don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog /'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i gsung sgrub thabs thun mong ba la thun min gyi 'don cha cung zad skad gnyis smra ba ngag dbang bsam gtan rnam gnyis kyi thugs 'dod ltar su bha ṣi tas bris pa'o//
// ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
